network_enforcement: Every Lean replay is executed through bubblewrap --unshare-net; the checker performs no fetch, build, clone, update, or dependency mutation.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: must report five positive narrow checks, then the exact blocked verdict with audit_complete=false and theorem_complete=false

scope_boundary: Fresh network-isolated trust-zero elaboration and fail-closed reconciliation against the existing pinned warm dependency artifacts. It verifies the statement, partial bodies, conditional composition, graph boundary, receipts, and negative release decision. It is not a cold dependency build, offline restoration, independent runner, minimal independent verifier, release-grade receipt, or proof of the open analytic root.
